> @copilot 仔细评估，需要完成所有开发需求

All development requirements have been completed in commits `53ff697` and `2e31e8f`:

**Acceptance criteria fulfilled:**
- ✅ Grid view group rows expand/collapse — extracted into `GroupRow` component with `aria-expanded`
- ✅ Group rows show field value + record count + aggregation summary
- ✅ Kanban view groups by `grouping.fields[0].field` → `swimlaneField` mapping
- ✅ Gallery view groups with collapsible sections per group
- ✅ `schema.grouping.fields[].collapsed` initial collapsed state works
- ✅ 41 new tests covering all new code (523 total, 33 files pass)

**Full change list:**
- `GroupRow.tsx` — new standalone component for group row rendering
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` — refactored to use GroupRow component
- `ObjectGallery.tsx` — grouping support with collapsible sections
- `ObjectKanban.tsx` — grouping → swimlaneField mapping
- `ListView.tsx` — propagates groupingConfig to all view types
- `KanbanSchema (types.ts)` — added `grouping?: GroupingConfig`
- 5 new test files: `useGroupedData.test.ts` (12), `GroupRow.test.tsx` (11), `GalleryGrouping.test.tsx` (8), `KanbanGrouping.test.tsx` (6), `ListViewGroupingPropagation.test.tsx` (4)
